entries.plain_definition: A written Boolean rule built from variables and operators.
entries.technical_definition: A syntax tree whose evaluation maps a complete variable assignment to one Boolean value.
entries.common_confusion: The expression is syntax; it is not the same object as the function it denotes.

entries.plain_definition: The true-or-false output produced for every assignment.
entries.technical_definition: The assignment-to-output mapping denoted by one or more equivalent Boolean expressions.
entries.common_confusion: Different expression trees can denote the same Boolean function.

entries.plain_definition: A tree representation of the written expression.
entries.technical_definition: A syntax node graph before structural sharing; the raw-AST ablation may recompute repeated subtrees.
entries.common_confusion: Raw AST is not the strongest generic comparator.

entries.plain_definition: A matrix layout of a Boolean function's truth values.
entries.technical_definition: A dense output indexed by assignments over declared row and column variable sets.
entries.common_confusion: Not every use of the label CM refers to this dense artifact.

entries.plain_definition: A reusable graph program for Boolean computation.
entries.technical_definition: A canonicalized and interned CMNode DAG with simplification, sharing-aware flattening, and multiple evaluation/materialization paths.
entries.common_confusion: CM-IR is not the same object as the dense matrix returned by materialize_cm.

entries.plain_definition: Variables that can change the function's output.
entries.technical_definition: The variable set retained by an expression/IR node after simplification and fixed bindings.
entries.common_confusion: Live support can be smaller than the ambient or syntactic variable universe.

entries.plain_definition: Variables included in the surrounding assignment layout.
entries.technical_definition: The declared row/column or corpus variable axes, including variables that may be semantically dead for one function.
entries.common_confusion: Ambient count is not a substitute for live support.

entries.plain_definition: Compute a repeated subtree once and reuse it.
entries.technical_definition: Structural sharing/interning of repeated expression subtrees.
entries.common_confusion: Plain CSE does not necessarily flatten eligible associative chains.

entries.plain_definition: CSE plus safe flattening of associative chains.
entries.technical_definition: The corrected strong generic comparator: structural sharing with flatten=True while preserving shared nodes.
entries.common_confusion: It is stronger than raw AST and plain unflattened CSE.

entries.plain_definition: An ordered list of loads and operations lowered from a shared graph.
entries.technical_definition: A linear postorder execution representation with one instruction per unique DAG node and explicit slot dependencies.
entries.common_confusion: FlatProgram is not CSE-flat and is not the same thing as packed word storage.

entries.plain_definition: One-time work to build a reusable compiled artifact.
entries.technical_definition: Compiler/canonicalizer time measured separately from evaluation.
entries.common_confusion: Preparation must not be blended into a bare-kernel ratio unless explicitly declared.

entries.plain_definition: Repeated execution after the program and environment already exist.
entries.technical_definition: The compiled-program measurement boundary used by the corrected CM/CSE-flat ratios.
entries.common_confusion: It is not a public-wrapper or end-to-end result.

entries.plain_definition: The convenient public call including surrounding work.
entries.technical_definition: The complete wrapper boundary reported separately from bare compiled evaluation.
entries.common_confusion: A faster kernel does not imply a faster wrapper.

entries.plain_definition: How many evaluations are needed to repay extra preparation.
entries.technical_definition: The solution to accumulated preparation plus per-evaluation cost under a declared model.

entries.plain_definition: Many truth values stored in machine words or a big integer.
entries.technical_definition: An exact truth-vector execution backend with explicit ordering and width masking.
entries.common_confusion: Packed execution is not automatically a dense CM.

entries.plain_definition: The repository's experimental recognition and computation-selection research program.
entries.technical_definition: A project label for frozen milestone studies with learned proposal paths, exact controls, verification, and explicit promotion decisions.
entries.common_confusion: The current authoritative sources do not supply an expansion; scripts must not invent one, and engineering verification is not scientific generalization or deployment.
